facts: The Paige knowledge base contains 10 topics covering every major MotoPass feature and subsystem.
Each topic is a standalone JSON file in research/paige/*-knowledge.json, auto-discovered by import.meta.glob.
Topics are hot-loadable: adding a new JSON file automatically includes it in Paige's RAG retrieval with zero code changes.
The knowledge base currently indexes 220 facts and 73 member scripts across 10 topics.
Search is token-based with topic-name boost: queries are tokenized, scored against topic text, and ranked by overlap.
The KB badge in Paige's chat header shows live topic count and total fact count.
Every topic includes honest rules — non-negotiable guidelines that Paige must follow when discussing that topic.
Member scripts provide pre-written, vetted answers for the most common member questions per topic.
The knowledge base was designed to be self-documenting: each JSON file is both machine-readable for RAG and human-readable for developers.

satohash.description: Satohash.io timestamp engine, OpenTimestamps, SHA-256 hashing, Bitcoin proof lifecycle

intel-pipeline.description: Daily automated research pipeline, source adapters, self-healing loop, freshness tracking

vault-stamping.description: Document Vault, file stamping workflow, shared registry, export/import

stacking-portfolio.description: Portfolio management, Stack Simulator, Value Forks, Compare matrix, BTC dual price

distressed-marketplace.description: Proof-gated listings, curated vs permissionless lanes, escrow templates, deal rooms

proactive-alerts.description: Nostr-based rule-change alerts, alert types, subscription, portfolio-aware filtering

verification-lifecycle.description: Hash generation, OTS verification, batch verify, Nostr attestation, security guards

onboarding-matching.description: Registration flow, program discovery, filters, Gold Standard, application, launch gates

btcmap-discovery.description: BTC Map merchant directory, density heatmap, cluster map, Lightning readiness

i18n-internationalization.description: 10-language support, browser detection, per-route overrides, RTL, keyboard shortcut

architecture.indexing: Token-based: facts + member_scripts + topic name (split on hyphens)
architecture.search: Score = 2 per matching token + 3 bonus for exact topic-name token match
architecture.fallback: English for missing translations, key name as last resort
